messages.author: d8f29a4621e38cf3
messages.subject: Linear mixed effect model
parts:
Hi, everyone. Right now I try to fit a linear mixed effect model, and there are two indexes for the response and covariate, but I continue to get the error: 

Error in processBUGScode(recurseCode, nextContextID, lineNumber = lineNumber,  :
  Error: = not allowed in BUGS code in u = beta * x[i, j] + beta0[i]

My sample code is:

code=nimbleCode({
  for (i in 1:100) {
    beta0[i]~dnorm(0,1)
    for (j in 1:120) {
      y[i,j] ~ dnorm(u[i,j],tau)
      u=beta*x[i,j]+beta0[i]
    }
  }
  tau~dgamma(1,1)
  beta~dnorm(0,1)
})

I am wondering if anyone has any idea about this? Thanks!

messages.author: 7878556d408ec9ec
messages.subject: Re: Linear mixed effect model
parts:
Hi, you need to add index to u when you calculate it, ie u[i,j] = beta *....

Cheers,
Wei
